apply_mlm_noise_to_text: apply MLM noise to text using a T5 tokenizer with configurable noise density and span length
process_example_with_mlm_masking: process an example by applying T5 MLM masking to the target text field and saving metadata
evaluate_prediction_with_metrics: evaluate a prediction against ground truths using accuracy, F1, and ROUGE metrics
filter_results_by_id: filter retrieved results by removing the passage being denoised from the result set
initialize_mlm_task: initialize an MLM task with options for noise density, span length, and text maxlength
